label.desc: Optional title rendered above the form

size.desc: Control size; inherit follows the nearest form or toolbar

labelHidden.desc: Keep the label accessible without displaying it

reserveFeedback.desc: Reserve one feedback line; omit to inherit

ariaLabel.desc: Names the native form without requiring a visible heading.

enterBehavior.desc: Controls how Enter behaves inside text-like controls.
